goal: Take the exact 1280-node target - 256 primaries with four replicas each - on an operator-supplied fleet at any provider, unattended, without weakening exact scale, safety, evidence quality, or cleanup.

criteria.statement: Exact scale requests compile without downscaling, and a real execution above 200 nodes is reachable only through the named 1280-node exception with operator opt-in and cost acknowledgement.
The target shape places one nodehost per fleet host and keeps every shard's five members on distinct nodehosts, spreading primaries evenly whatever the fleet size.
A real native multi-host run requests and independently observes exactly 1280 healthy Valkey nodes on the operator's fleet.
Telemetry, command logs, process journals, and evidence transfer remain complete, bounded, and attributable at 1280 nodes.
Fault containment, recovery, restart, teardown, and deterministic cleanup remain bounded and ownership-safe at the run's own density.
A run renders a validated, entirely offline report from its own artifacts, pass or fail, without a second command.
